install.lead: Add CatCheck to your home screen to open it quickly like an app: full screen, its own icon, no need to type the address again.
install.standaloneBody: This window is running full screen, which means CatCheck already has a shortcut on this device. On other devices you'll still need to add it.
install.promptBody: Your browser says it can install CatCheck. Tap the button below, then confirm in the browser's dialog.
install.promptAccepted: Your browser accepted the request. Check your home screen or app list.
install.promptDismissed: You closed the dialog. You can install it any time, or do it manually using the steps below.
install.promptUnavailableBody: The automatic install button only appears in some browsers, and only after you've used the site for a while. Safari on iPhone and iPad never shows it. The manual steps below always work.
install.iosStep1: Open CatCheck in Safari. Other browsers on iOS can't add it to the home screen.
install.iosStep2: Tap the Share button in the toolbar — the square with an upward arrow.
install.iosStep3: Scroll down and choose “Add to Home Screen”.
install.iosStep4: Name it, then tap “Add”. The CatCheck icon will appear on your home screen.
install.androidStep1: Tap the three-dot button in the top right, next to the address bar.
install.androidStep2: Choose “Install app”, or “Add to Home screen” if you don't see the first option.
install.androidStep3: Confirm in the dialog that appears.
install.desktopStep1: Click the install icon at the end of the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose the option to install CatCheck.
install.note1: This is just a full-screen shortcut. Your account, data and camera permissions stay the same as in the browser.
install.note2: CatCheck still needs a connection to send scan photos and load results — adding it to the home screen doesn't make it work offline.
install.note3: To remove it, delete the icon from your home screen like any other app.
